about: Approved ChickenGPT community chicken facts. Everything on the main branch was reviewed and merged by the site owner. chickengpt.net loads this file as plain data.

facts.fact: Silkie chickens have black skin and black bones, blue earlobes, fur-like feathers that can't fly, and five toes on each foot instead of the usual four.
facts.quip: Goth, fluffy and over-equipped. Living the dream.
